description: Checks up to 5 EU VAT numbers (country code + number, e.g. DE143208032) with the European Commission's VIES service and returns valid yes/no, the registered name and address when the member state releases them, and any member-state error. Some member states do not release names or addresses, and VIES can be unavailable for one country at a time. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

vat.description: 1 to 5 VAT numbers separated by commas, each with a 2-letter EU country code
